description: This file is a shell script for rewriting git revision history, including functions for filtering commits, setting author info, and updating refs. It is part of a git filtering tool, likely used for history rewriting and transformation.

methods.name: warn
methods.description: Outputs warning messages to standard error.

methods.name: map
methods.description: Maps a commit or object ID to its rewritten value, using stored mappings.

methods.name: skip_commit
methods.description: Skips a commit during rewriting by outputting its mapped parents.

methods.name: git_commit_non_empty_tree
methods.description: Creates a commit only if the tree is non-empty, otherwise skips.

methods.name: die
methods.description: Outputs an error message and terminates execution.

methods.name: finish_ident
methods.description: Outputs shell commands to set Git author/committer identities.

methods.name: set_ident
methods.description: Sets author and committer info from current commit.
